notes: Initial N-14 8C (filed 2021-06-22) for the reorganizations of two Nuveen municipal closed-end funds (NXQ, NXR) into NXP; each reorganization is not contingent on the other. This preliminary filing leaves the meeting date, record date and expected closing date blank ('[●], 2021'), so meeting_date, record_date and expected_close are null (the closing is stated only as 'expected to be on or about [], 2021'). The Agreement (Appendix A, Article XI) has no outside/automatic termination date, so termination_date is null. conditions 'other' covers customary certificates and legal opinions, accuracy of representations and the Target Fund's pre-closing distribution. No exchange ratio, cash or collar stated (NAV-for-NAV, cash only in lieu of fractional shares). Spans keep the text file's cp1252 control characters (e.g. U+0092 for apostrophes) verbatim.
